name: Key Fob Battery
summary: The fob type decides everything. Comfort Access keys use a replaceable CR2032 (3 sources, general BMW, not E90-specific). Standard E90 keys are rechargeable (3 sources): charged by driving with the key in the ignition, inductive charging suggested by forums, battery not owner-replaceable without cutting/soldering. Part number for a rechargeable cell (66126912985) found at one retailer only. Opening steps for a CA fob are corroborated at a general level. VIN option (Comfort Access) not decoded.
variantDependencies: Comfort Access (SA 322) key: CR2032 coin cell, user replaceable (YouCanic, Motorwerks, 1addicts thread).
Non-Comfort Access key: rechargeable cell, charges in ignition; case not designed to open (YouCanic, Jerry, reddit E90).
Some E90 keys have the cell spot-welded; replacement needs soldering (reddit E90 thread). One YouCanic comment claims VL2020 on E90 - unverified.
CR2450 applies to other smart keys (YouCanic, FCP Euro for other models); not shown for E90.

tools.item: Emergency/valet key blade or small flat screwdriver (tape tip) to open
Soldering iron, knife, glue, multimeter (rechargeable key cell swap only)

parts.item: BMW rechargeable key battery 3.2V (listed for 328i at FCP Euro; fitment year not given)
CR2450 BMW keyless remote battery (listed for other models)

specs.value: Rechargeable, charged via ignition or inductive pad
Jerry: about 30 minutes driving gives limited use, dead key long; YouCanic suggests ~2 h trip. Numbers differ.
YouCanic describes ignition-position/lock-button sequence; no second source

steps.title: Identify key type
steps.instruction: If the key opens with a valet blade and a coin cell, it is Comfort Access; if the case has no access and is a sealed rechargeable, it is the standard key.
warnings: Check the car for Comfort Access door-handle sensors; owner to confirm.

steps.title: Comfort Access: open fob
steps.instruction: Press the side tab, withdraw the valet key, use the blade or a taped small screwdriver in the gap to separate the case.

steps.title: Swap CR2032 and close
steps.instruction: Note polarity, replace cell, snap halves together, test lock/unlock.
warnings: Dead key can still start the car from the dash slot (1addicts thread, single source).

steps.title: Standard key: charge
steps.instruction: Leave key in ignition position 1/2 while driving or set on a wireless charger for hours.
warnings: Wireless-charger tip is forum advice only.

steps.title: Standard key: cell replacement
steps.instruction: Not a DIY-safe step: requires cutting case seam, desoldering and soldering a new cell and gluing; recommend dealer/locksmith.
warnings: Case damage, cut risk, polarity, dud cells.

steps.title: Re-sync procedure
steps.instruction: If remote does not respond, YouCanic describes an ignition and button sequence.
warnings: May require retries; if it fails, see dealer.

safety: Keep coin cells away from children and pets.
Wear gloves and cut away from body if opening a sealed key.
Note polarity before removing the old cell.
